```sql
SELECT
    d.batter,
    ROUND( (SUM(d.batter_runs)::numeric / COUNT(*)) * 100, 2 ) AS strike_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS powerplay_balls,
    SUM(d.batter_runs) AS powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries d
WHERE d.over_no BETWEEN 1 AND 6               -- powerplay overs
  AND (d.extras_type IS NULL OR d.extras_type <> 'wide')  -- exclude wides (not a legal ball)
GROUP BY d.batter
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500                         -- at least 500 powerplay balls faced
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
